Cut from genuine crocodile leather in a deep, dark blue, this wallet keeps its shape and structure with age rather than losing either. The scale pattern is natural, not embossed - no two panels match exactly, which is part of what genuine exotic leather looks like.

The interior holds cards and cash in a slim, flat profile that doesn't bulge a jacket pocket. Edges are hand-stitched and burnished by hand in Italy, a finishing step that keeps the leather from fraying at the seams over years of use.

Sourced and traded in compliance with CITES regulations for exotic leather, with documentation available on request. Made in small batches by hand.

The Silhouette

The Narcos sunglasses is rendered in a hand-polished transparent bottle green crystal acetate. This rich emerald tone offers an alternative to traditional black or tortoiseshell frames. Renowned for boosting color contrast and depth perception, these lenses excel in both bright sunlight and variable overcast conditions. Engineered to offer complete clarity, eliminate glare, and shield your eyes with 100% UVA/UVB protection, they represent high-definition vision.

  • Frame Material: Premium organic cellulose crystal acetate (Transparent Bottle Green / Emerald)

title: SAC - Black
body_html:
SAC is a refined Italian leather backpack made from grained Togo leather - a material chosen for its durability, soft hand feel, and the way it deepens in character over time. The silhouette is compact and clean: L 19 × H 28 × D 9 cm - enough for your daily carry, nothing unnecessary.

Inside, the bag is fully lined in smooth goat leather. This is not an afterthought - the goat leather interior creates a refined contrast against the Togo exterior and makes the bag notably more durable inside where most bags fail first. The closure is a palladium-finished brass fitting.

SAC transitions naturally between uses: wear it as a backpack for city days or travel, or carry it as a crossbody leather bag. The straps are designed to work both ways.

Handmade by Italian artisans in small batches. A black leather backpack that does not announce itself - it simply performs.

Details

· Exterior: Grained Togo calf leather

· Interior: Full goat leather lining

· Closure: Palladium-finished brass

· Dimensions: L 19 × H 28 × D 9 cm

· Carry: Backpack or crossbody bag

· Made in Italy by hand

· Available in multiple colors

title: Table Trunk
body_html:
A contemporary ode to the great era of travel.
Handcrafted in Italy from full-grain calf leather, the Table Trunk reinterprets the classic travel trunk as a refined centerpiece for modern living.

Wrapped in orange full-grain leather with blue nubuck details, and finished with fine leather fringes along the base, it balances structure with softness.

The trunk opens to a lined interior in natural cotton canvas, offering discreet storage. Every element - from the hand-stitched leather to the solid brass hardware galvanized in palladium - is crafted entirely by hand in Italian ateliers.

Measuring 120 x 60 x 40 cm, the Table Trunk unites the precision of fine leatherwork with the ease of contemporary design.

title: The Mirror Handbag - Black
body_html:
A compact, structured shape with one unusual detail: open the top and a mirror sits built into the lid - genuinely useful, not decorative. The Mirror Handbag is sized for what you actually carry through the day: your phone, cards, keys and a lipstick you can reach without digging.

Made in Italy from black calf leather with a tweed cotton panel, chosen for the contrast between structure and texture, the bag holds its silhouette without feeling rigid in the hand. The clasp is solid brass finished in palladium, with a small lock and key to keep the contents secure throughout the day and evening. A chain strap allows it to be carried crossbody, over the shoulder or short in hand.

Made in small batches, each piece carries the natural variations of the leather and the character of individual hand finishing.

body_html:
A large tote cut from Italian calf leather, with the natural grain left visible rather than corrected flat, so no two bags carry exactly the same surface.

The interior is lined in cotton - a light lining that keeps the weight down on a bag this size and leaves room for a laptop and documents. The handles are cut from the same hide as the body.

Made by hand in Italy.

title: Vault Bag
body_html:
A structured trunk-style bag built the way a trunk is built - a rigid form wrapped in calf leather, which is why it holds its shape whether it is full or empty.

The interior is lined in Alcantara, a dense microfiber that stays smooth against what it holds. The closure is a metal lock rather than a magnet or a zip, and the hardware is solid brass galvanized in palladium.

The leather shoulder strap detaches, so the same piece is carried by hand or across the body. Made by hand in Italy.

title: Wine Holder Leather Box
body_html:
A case built to carry two bottles, cut from Italian Nabuk calf leather and buffed to a short nap so the surface reads matte rather than polished.

It opens down the middle into two lined compartments, each with its own leather strap to hold a bottle steady in transit. The lining is soft, so the glass and its label travel against a giving surface rather than a rigid one. Two clasps and two side latches hold the case shut while it is carried, not only while it is set down. Brass studs run the seams and brass caps protect the corners.

Sized to standard bottles. Made by hand in Italy.
